title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Scott released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released FB Lucas Scott from the practice squad.
items.impact: Baltimore signed QB Austin Reed to the practice squad as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elliott Davison released by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots released Elliott Davison.
items.impact: Davison will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Tupou released by Giants
items.desc: The Giants released Josh Tupou.
items.impact: Tupou will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) practicing this week
items.desc: Texans OL Blake Fisher is practicing this week.
items.impact: Fisher underwent thumb surgery for ulnar collateral ligament injury. His presence at practice is a good sign.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalyn Armour-Davis signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed CB Jalyn Armour-Davis.
items.impact: Armour-Davis started 10 games for Tennessee last season before suffering a torn Achilles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Campbell (neck) improving per Dan Campbell
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Jack Campbell is improving.
items.impact: Campbell suffered a neck injury early in the fourth quarter of Sunday's win over the Vikings. He remains in the hospital.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cashius Howell (wrist) placed on IR
items.desc: The Bengals placed rookie DE Cashius Howell on injured reserve.
items.impact: Howell will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) not expected to practice Wednesday or Thursday
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said he doesn't expect Cade Mays to practice on Wednesday or Thursday.
items.impact: Mays suffered a low ankle sprain on Sunday. He appears to be a longshot to play in Week 9 against the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) will not return Week 9
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Kerby Joseph will not return in Week 9 against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Joseph will have to wait at least one more game to make his season debut. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: K.J. Britt signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed LB K.J. Britt to their active roster from the Patriots' practice squad.
items.impact: Britt will add depth in the linebacker room for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vega Ioane (knee) expected to play Week 9
items.desc: Vega Ioane is expected to play on Thursday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ioane will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday heading into a game on a short week for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Moody expected to start at kicker for Ravens Thursday
items.desc: Jake Moody is expected to start at kicker for the Ravens on Thursday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tyler Loop could be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Loop could be placed on IR
items.desc: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said kicker Tyler Loop could land on injured reserve.
items.impact: It is unclear what exactly Loop is dealing with. Jake Moody will serve as the kicker on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adrian Martinez works out for Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens worked out QB Adrian Martinez.
items.impact: Baltimore continues to try to address the quarterback position after losing Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injuries. Martinez was the UFL MVP in 2024.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kedon Slovis signs with Ravens
items.desc: Kedon Slovis signed with the Ravens on Tuesday.
items.impact: Slovis had been on the Packers' practice squad, but he will now join the Ravens' active roster. The Ravens are in a real fix at the QB position, with Joe Fagnano, Austin Reed, and Slovis as their current options.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Austin Reed joins Ravens practice squad
items.desc: Austin Reed signed with the Ravens' practice squad on Monday.
items.impact: Reed spent some time around Ravens' camp this past summer, and with the team suddenly in dire straits at quarterback, he has been brought back. Reed will likely be elevated to the main roster before Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Daniel Jones struggles in Week 8, to remain starter
items.desc: Daniel Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback in Week 9 against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Jones completed 19 of 28 passes for just 144 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions before exiting Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars. The veteran QB was replaced late in the game by backup Anthony Richardson, but Jones will move forward as the starter for head coach Shane Steichen, at least for one more week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Joe Fagnano (ankle) limited Monday, chance to start Thursday
items.desc: Joe Fagnano (ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Monday's walkthrough.
items.impact: The Ravens' quarterback situation could not be more of a mess right now. Fagnano made his unexpected NFL debut on Sunday after both Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) went down. Fagnano is in line to start Thursday, but he is also dealing with an ankle issue. The Ravens have already added Austin Reed and Kedon Slovis this week, but Fagnano still "has a chance" to be ready per head coach Jesse Minter.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Seahawks D/ST struggles in loss Monday
items.desc: The Seahawks' D/ST logged just one sack and one fumble recovery while allowing 34 points in Monday night's loss the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Seattle normally has a very stout defense, but they got outclassed by Chicago on Monday night. They ended up giving up 34 points over the course of the night, which led to yet another loss for the Seahawks. This unit will have a great opportunity to bounce back in a matchup against the Cardinals next week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jason Myers misses two kicks in loss Monday
items.desc: Jason Myers went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempt and missed his lone extra-point attempt in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Myers missed two kicks on Monday night. One of them wasn't his fault, as it was blocked by Chicago, but there were still four points left out on the field by the veteran kicker. He isn't expected to be among the top kickers in fantasy over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Holani quiet in loss Monday
items.desc: George Holani rushed the ball one time for nine yards and failed to catch his lone target in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Holani saw just two opportunities on Monday night, which predictably left him with a poor fantasy total. He is not very involved on Seattle's offense at this point, and it looked like rookie Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet will be their two top guys moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper Kupp finds end zone Monday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp caught one pass for seven yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Kupp was able to catch a touchdown on Monday night, but that was his only reception, so he still had a terrible fantasy total over the course of the game. He remains entirely off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: AJ Barner catches two passes Monday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 2-of-5 targets for 23 yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Barner was targeted five times on Monday night, but he was only able to turn that into two catches for 23 yards. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emanuel Wilson entirely uninvolved in loss Monday
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson did not see a single opportunity in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: It was known that Wilson would see a reduction in workload this week with Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price making their return from injury, but it was shocking to see that he did not log even a single opportunity over the course of the night. The team entirely wrote him out of the game plan, which burned any fantasy managers who dared start him after his quality performance in Week 7. He may not be an involved member of this offense moving forward, in which case he would easily be safe to drop.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
items.desc: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Charbonnet quiet in return game Monday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet rushed the ball six times for 23 yards and caught three passes for six yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Charbonnet made his season debut for the Seahawks on Monday night after missing an extended period of time recovering from a significant knee injury. He didn't make headlines in his first game back, however, racking up just 29 total yards on his nine touches over the course of the night. He will likely continue to get more involved as he continues to ramp back up to a full workload over the next couple of weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Darnold tosses two touchdowns Monday
items.desc: Sam Darnold completed 17-of-34 passing attempts for 188 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: The veteran didn't have his best game on Monday night. He finished with a solid two touchdowns, but outside of that he had a subpar completion percent, wasn't able to reach 200 passing yards, and threw an interception at one point. This wasn't a great game from Darnold and he remains nothing more than a streaming option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba stellar in loss Monday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 6-of-11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba was by far Seattle's leading receiver on Monday night, finishing with 92 more yards than their second highest contributor. He was also able to get into the end zone again and finished with a terrific fantasy total, which just adds to the insane pace that he has established over the first half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bears D/ST allows 17 points in win Monday
items.desc: The Bears' D/ST logged three sacks and one interception while allowing 17 points in Monday night's win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Chicago's defense actually looked effective on Monday night. They were able to hold the Seahawks to just 17 points over the course of the game, which made it much easier for their own offense to put the game out of reach. This unit will have another primetime matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 9.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cairo Santos scores ten points in win Monday
items.desc: Cairo Santos went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made both of his field-goal attempts in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Santos was perfect on Monday night, making all six of his kicks in a comfortable win over the Seahawks. He has been producing very well lately and should be started in most leagues at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kalif Raymond underwhelming in win Monday
items.desc: Kalif Raymond caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to contribute much on Monday, catching just two passes in a win over the Seahawks. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, even if he is capable of having a boom game every so often.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Roschon Johnson quiet in win Monday
items.desc: Roschon Johnson rushed the ball five times for 17 yards and caught one pass for 11 yards in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Johnson saw a total of six touches on Monday with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) still out for the Bears. He wasn't able to do much with his limited work, however, finishing with just 28 total yards in the team's win over Seattle. He remains off of the fantasy radar at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday
items.desc: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colston Loveland catches seven passes Monday
items.desc: Colston Loveland hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 65 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Loveland saw good involvement on Monday night. He was tied for the most targets and receptions out of anyone on the team, and he was able to turn his seven catches into 65 yards against the Seahawks. Fantasy managers should feel good about his chances at a breakout over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Luther Burden III finds end zone Monday
items.desc: Luther Burden III caught 7-of-9 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Burden looked great on Monday night. He caught seven passes over the course of the game and was able to get into the end zone on one of them, which left him with a good fantasy total. He has been heating up lately and should be started in all league formats for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D'Andre Swift scores three touchdowns in win Monday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift rushed the ball 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns while adding two catches for ten yards through the air in Monday night's 24-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Swift pulled off the hat trick on Monday night, getting into the end zone three different times in a big win over Seattle. Outside of that he wasn't very efficient and didn't get a lot of work as a receiver, so while his fantasy total was very good, it didn't quite reach dominant levels. He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Williams scores once in big win Monday
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 24-of-34 passing attempts for 247 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Williams played very well on Monday night, but since most of Chicago's touchdowns came on the ground, that didn't come through on the stat sheet very strongly. Still, fantasy managers should be ecstatic with how this Chicago looks at this point in the season and should expect Williams to be a strong starter over the back half of the year.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lions D/ST solid in Week 8
items.desc: The Lions D/ST recorded three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense made stops when it counted, allowing just 266 offensive yards in Sunday's win. The unit will look for another steady performance in a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Bates misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Jake Bates converted his only extra point attempt while also making two of three field goal attempts to record seven points in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: Bates has taken advantage of sizeable opportunities behind a high-powered offense, finishing with seven or more points in each of his seven contests. The kicker remains a reliable option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Vikings D/ST does its part in Week 8
items.desc: The Vikings D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing one turnover in a 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was unable to contain a physical Detroit ground attack, allowing 230 rushing yards and 5.9 yards per carry in the loss. The unit faces another stiff test against a physical Buffalo Bills offense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Reichard misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Will Reichard converted his only extra point attempt while also missing his lone field goal attempt in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Reichard struggled to make an impact Sunday, registering less than nine points for the first time in his last six contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cowboys D/ST implodes in Week 8
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering five sacks in a 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was unable to make stops consistently Sunday, allowing over 200 rushing yards in a losing effort. The unit will look to take advantage of an underperforming Indianapolis Colts offense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey converted all three extra point attempts as well as three of his four field goal attempts to finish with 12 points in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: Aubrey has been impactful of late, recording 10 or more points in five of his last seven contests. The kicker will look to offer another explosive performance in a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cardinals D/ST records four sacks in Week 8
items.desc: The Cardinals D/ST recorded four sacks while failing to force a turnover in a 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was able to stand tall when it counted Sunday, allowing just 288 offensive yards in the comeback win. The unit will be difficult to trust entering a tough Week 9 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chad Ryland misses extra point in Week 8
items.desc: Chad Ryland converted both of his field goal attempts while also converting three of his four extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Ryland has caught fire of late, recording nine or more points in each of his last three contests. The kicker will look to stay hot behind an Arizona offense with newly named starting quarterback Gardner Minshew behind center in a tough Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
items.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) seen walking without crutches or brace
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling was seen walking in locker room without crutches or a brace on Monday.
items.impact: Stribling has been on injured reserve since the season opener. He appears to be progressing, but remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Pearce Jr. completes eight-game suspension
items.desc: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. has completed his eight-game suspension.
items.impact: Pearce is eligible to make his season debut in Week 9 against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Bourne (ankle) could be out for season
items.desc: Cardinals WR Kendrick Bourne's ankle injury could end his season.
items.impact: Bourne had a non-contact injury with 21 seconds left in the first half of Sunday's game against the Cowboys. He is still undergoing tests.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) could practice this week
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said "it is looking more likely than not" that Terrance Ferguson returns to practice this week.
items.impact: Ferguson has been on injured reserve. He will have his 21-day practice window opened when he returns to the field.
